_doc: Dev container building blocks. A pack stack lists the blocks it needs (devcontainer: [...]); gw devcontainer merges them for every target. image: the first block with one wins, otherwise base. features/ports/extensions/env are merged, post commands run in order. check proves the toolchain inside the container (the framework CI runs it).

android-sdk.post: mkdir -p ~/android-sdk/cmdline-tools && curl -fsSLo /tmp/clt.zip https://dl.google.com/android/repository/commandlinetools-linux-16111833_latest.zip && unzip -q -o /tmp/clt.zip -d /tmp/clt && rm -rf ~/android-sdk/cmdline-tools/latest && mv /tmp/clt/cmdline-tools ~/android-sdk/cmdline-tools/latest && rm -rf /tmp/clt /tmp/clt.zip
android-sdk.note: Android SDK licences are yours to accept: run `sdkmanager --licenses`, then `sdkmanager "platform-tools" "platforms;android-35" "build-tools;35.0.0"` inside the container. The emulator runs on the host or in CI, not in this container.

desktop.note: A desktop for GUI tests: open http://localhost:6080 (noVNC; default password vscode).

tauri-deps.post: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends libwebkit2gtk-4.1-dev libappindicator3-dev librsvg2-dev patchelf build-essential

gtk.post: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends meson ninja-build pkg-config build-essential libgtk-4-dev libgtk-3-dev

qt.post: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends cmake ninja-build build-essential qt6-base-dev qt6-declarative-dev libgl1-mesa-dev

zephyr.note: Run `west init -l . && west update` once; install the Zephyr SDK for your boards (https://docs.zephyrproject.org/latest/develop/toolchains/zephyr_sdk.html).

godot.post: curl -fsSLo /tmp/godot.zip https://github.com/godotengine/godot/releases/download/4.7.2-stable/Godot_v4.7.2-stable_linux.x86_64.zip && sudo unzip -q -o /tmp/godot.zip -d /opt/godot && sudo ln -sf /opt/godot/Godot_v4.7.2-stable_linux.x86_64 /usr/local/bin/godot && rm /tmp/godot.zip
